sentences.en: I packed some spare socks in my bag just in case.
sentences.zh: 我在包里打包了一些备用袜子以防万一。

sentences.en: The hiker always carries a few pairs of spare socks for emergencies.
sentences.zh: 那位远足者总是带几双备用袜子以备不时之需。

sentences.en: Make sure to bring an extra pair of spare socks when you go camping this weekend.
sentences.zh: 这个周末你去野营的时候记得多带一双备用袜子。
